oromo: Hoggantoonni dhaabbilee teeknooloojii gurguddoo kan akka Anthropic fi OpenAI, guddina 'Artificial Intelligence' (AI) irratti sodaa gaaga'ama lubbuu ilmaan namaaf qabuun qabxiin isaa akka gadi bu'u gaafachaa jiru. Haa ta'u malee, biyyoonni akka Ameerikaa fi Chaayinaa dorgommii teeknooloojii kana keessatti wal dura darbanii injifachuuf waan yaadaniif, sochii kana dhaabuun ykn suuta jechuun ulfaataa dha. Kana malees, sochii kana addunyaa guutuu irratti akkamitti akka to'atamu ykn hordofamu ilaalchisee amantiin namoota ogummaa kana qaban biratti hiri'ataa dhufeera.

title: ​Bangsamoro’s parliamentary election is a turning point
english: The Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao is holding its first parliamentary election, marking a major step forward after years of armed conflict and peace negotiations. This vote signals the end of the interim transitional government and serves as a crucial test for the region's commitment to democracy. The election represents the culmination of a long struggle for self-determination by the Moro people to secure greater political and fiscal autonomy within the Philippines.
amharic: የባንግሳሞሮ ራስ-ገዝ ክልል የመጀመሪያውን የፓርላማ ምርጫ በማካሄድ ላይ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ለዓመታት የቆየውን የትጥቅ ግጭት ተከትሎ የመጣ ትልቅ የሰላም ምዕራፍ ነው። ይህ ምርጫ ጊዜያዊ አስተዳደሩ መጠናቀቁን የሚያበስር እና የክልሉን የዲሞክራሲ ሂደት የሚፈትሽ ወሳኝ ክስተት ነው። ምርጫው የሞሮ ህዝብ ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲያደርግ የነበረውን ራስን በራስ የማስተዳደር እና በፊሊፒንስ ውስጥ የፖለቲካና የኢኮኖሚ ነፃነት የማግኘት ትግል ውጤት ነው።
oromo: Naannoon Ofiin Bulu Bangsamoro filannoo paarlaman isa jalqabaa gaggeessaa jiraachuu isaa, kunis waldhabdee hidhannoo fi marii nagaa dheeraa booda tarkaanfii guddaa taasifameedha. Filannoon kun mootummaan cehumsaa akka xumuramu kan godhuufi adeemsa dimokiraasii naannichaa kan madaaluudha. Filannoon kun qabsoo ummatni Moro waggoota dheeraaf ofiin of bulchuufi biyya Filiphiinsi keessatti mirga siyaasaa fi dinagdee gonfachuuf godhaa turan bu’aa qabatamaa dha.

title: Haaland goal sees 10-men City beat United in controversial Manchester derby
english: Despite having a player sent off, Manchester City managed to defeat Manchester United 1-0 in a contentious Manchester derby thanks to a goal from Erling Haaland. Phil Foden received a red card early in the game, but City's midfield maintained control to secure the win for manager Enzo Maresca. The winning goal was disputed due to claims of interference, further adding to the tension during a match where United fans also protested against their own club's management.
amharic: አንድ ተጫዋች በቅጣት ከሜዳ ቢሰናበትም፣ ማንቸስተር ሲቲ በኤርሊንግ ሃላንድ ግብ ማንቸስተር ዩናይትድን 1-0 በማሸነፍ አወዛጋቢውን የከተማውን ደርቢ በድል ተወጥቷል። ፊል ፎደን በጨዋታው መጀመሪያ ላይ ቀይ ካርድ ቢመለከትም፣ የሲቲ አማካዮች ጥሩ ብቃት አሳይተው ለአሰልጣኝ ኢንዞ ማሬስካ ድል አስገኝተዋል። የድል ግቡም የተቆጠረበት መንገድ አወዛጋቢ በመሆኑ ጨዋታውን ይበልጥ አግሎታል፣ በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ የዩናይትድ ደጋፊዎች በክለባቸው አመራር ላይ ያላቸውን ቅሬታ በስታዲየሙ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Manchestar Siitin taphataan isaa tokko kaardii diimaan erga baafamee booda, goolii Erling Haaland lakkoofsisuun Manchestar Yuunaayitidii 1-0 injifachuu danda'eera. Fhil Fodaan jalqaba taphichaa irratti kaardii diimaan kan bahe ta'us, gareen Siitii dhiibbaa jabaa keessatti injifannoo argachuu danda'eera. Goolichi mormii kan kaase yoo tahu, taphichis dhiibbaa fi kaayyoo garaa garaa waliin kan geggeeffame dha; kana malees, deggertoonni Yuunaayitidii mormii bulchiinsa kilabichaa irratti qaban agarsiisaniiru.

title: Syrian child killed after roadside object explodes near Damascus
english: A young boy named Khaled al-Ajeelah tragically died after he touched a dangerous explosive left behind near Damascus. This incident highlights the ongoing danger that war remnants pose to civilians throughout Syria. Such explosive materials continue to threaten the lives of children and local communities across the country.
amharic: ካሊድ አል-አጂላህ የተባለ አነስተኛ ልጅ በደማስቆ አቅራቢያ ያገኘውን ፈንጂ በመንካቱ ምክንያት ህይወቱ አልፏል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በሶሪያ ውስጥ ባሉ የቀድሞ የጦርነት ቀጠናዎች የተተዉ ፈንጂዎች በዜጎች ላይ እያደረሱ ያለውን ከፍተኛ አደጋ ያሳያል። እነዚህ አደገኛ የጦር መሳሪያዎች በሶሪያ የሚገኙ ህፃናትን እና የህብረተሰብ ክፍሎችን ህይወት አሁንም እየቀጠፉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mucaan xiqqoon Kaaled al-Ajiilaah jedhamu tokko, naannoo Damasqoo keessatti meeshaa waraanaa durii hafe tokko yeroo tuqu waan dho'eef lubbuun isaa darbeera. Rakkoon kun miidhaa meeshaaleen waraanaa biyya keessatti hafan sabaaf qaqqabsiisaa jiran kan agarsiisuudha. Meeshaaleen dho'uuf qophiin kun hanga ammaattis jireenya ijoollee fi uummata naannichaa balaa keessa buusaa jiru.

title: Trump tells Zelenskyy to stop hitting Russian diesel supplies
english: US President Donald Trump has requested that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stop targeting Russian diesel facilities. Trump argues that these attacks are a major factor in rising global fuel prices, which are affecting American voters ahead of the midterm elections. While Ukraine maintains that Russian refineries are valid military targets that support the ongoing war, the US government is concerned about the broader economic impact of the supply disruption.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የዩክሬኑን ፕሬዚዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪን የሩሲያ የናፍጣ ማጣሪያ ጣቢያዎችን ጥቃት እንዲያቆሙ ጠይቀዋል። ትራምፕ እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲንር ማድረጋቸውን ገልጸው፣ ይህም በአሜሪካ መካከለኛ ምርጫ ላይ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ መሆኑን አስረድተዋል። ዩክሬን የሩሲያ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎች የጦርነቱን አቅም የሚያዳክሙ ህጋዊ ወታደራዊ ኢላማዎች ናቸው ብላ ብታምንም፣ አሜሪካ በነዳጅ አቅርቦት ላይ እየደረሰ ያለው መስተጓጎል በኢኮኖሚው ላይ ስላለው ጫና ስጋት ገብቷታል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp, pirezidaantii Yukireen Volodimir Zeelenskiin bakkeewwan suphaa boba’aa Raashiyaa irratti haleellaa akka dhaaban gaafataniiru. Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, haleellaan kun gatiin boba’aa addunyaa irra jiru akka dabalu kan godhe yoo ta’u, kunis filannoo Ameerikaa irratti dhiibbaa uumaa jira. Yukireen dhaabbileen boba’aa Raashiyaa gargaarsa waraanaa waan ta’aniif haleellaan isaan irratti raawwatamu fudhatama qaba jettee kan amantu yoo ta’u, Ameerikaan garuu rakkoon dhiyeessii boba’aa kun diinagdee addunyaa irratti miidhaa geessisaa jiraachuu isaa yaadda’uun ishee ibsameera.

title: French TV programme pulled after actress speaks out on Gaza
english: A French television station has removed an episode of the show La Grande Librairie from its online platform. This decision followed an appearance by actress Adèle Haenel, who used her airtime to criticize the ongoing conflict in Gaza as a genocide. The network stated that the episode will remain unavailable pending an official review by the national media regulatory authority.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ የቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያ የ'ላ ግራንድ ሊብሬሪ' ፕሮግራምን ከኦንላይን መድረኩ ላይ አውርዶታል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው ተዋናይዋ አዴል ሃኤኔል በፕሮግራሙ ላይ ቀርባ ጋዛ ውስጥ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል በማለት ከተናገረች በኋላ ነው። የቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያው ጉዳዩ በፈረንሳይ ሚዲያ ተቆጣጣሪ አካል እስኪጣራ ድረስ ፕሮግራሙ እንደማይተላለፍ ገልጿል።
oromo: Buufanni televishenii Faransaayi tokko sagantaa 'La Grande Librairie' jedhamu marsariitii isaa irraa kaaseera. Murtiin kun kan darbe, taphattuun ishii Adèle Haenel yeroo sagantichaa fayyadamtee waraana Gaazaatti geggeeffamaa jiru 'fixiinsa sanyii' jechuun erga balaaleffattee booda. Televishenichis dhimmi kun dhaabbata to'annoo miidiyaa Faransaayiin hanga qoratamuutti sagantichi akka hin dhihaanne ibseera.

title: Yemen’s military launches air raids on Houthi vehicles in Dhu Bab, Mocha
english: The Yemeni government's air force recently conducted military strikes against Houthi vehicles. These operations took place in the Dhu Bab and Mocha regions. This information was confirmed by a spokesperson for the national armed forces.
amharic: የየመን የአየር ኃይል በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ተሽከርካሪዎች ላይ የአየር ጥቃት መፈጸሙን አስታውቋል። ጥቃቱ የተካሄደው በዱ ባብ እና በሞቻ አካባቢዎች ነው። ይህንኑ የየመን መንግስት የጦር ኃይሎች ቃል አቀባይ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni qilleensaa kan mootummaa Yaman konkolaattota garee Hutiirratti haleellaa qilleensaa geggeessaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame naannoo Dhu Baab fi Mochaatti dha. Odeeffannoo kana kan mirkaneessan dubbi himaa waraana mootummaa Yamanidha.

title: Israeli settlers injure two Palestinians in attack east of Salfit
english: Two Palestinian men were hospitalized with injuries after being severely assaulted by Israeli settlers on their farmland near Salfit in the occupied West Bank. The victims were targeted while working in an area that serves as a busy transit route for local residents and students. This incident is part of a growing pattern of settler violence and harassment directed at Palestinians and their properties throughout the region.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ሳልፊት አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ የእርሻ መሬታቸው ላይ በእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በደረሰባቸው ከባድ ድብደባ ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን መቁሰላቸው ተዘግቧል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው አካባቢው በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እና ተማሪዎች በብዛት ጥቅም ላይ በሚውልበት ስፍራ ነው። ይህ ክስተት በአካባቢው እየጨመረ በመጣው የሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት እና የፍልስጤማውያን ላይ የሚደርሰው እንግልት አካል ነው።
oromo: Naannoo Salfiititti argamuun qonnaan bultoota Falastiin lama irratti garee Israa’el irraa dhufan kanaan miidhaan cimaan ga’eera. Namoonni miidhaman kun yeroo qonna isaanii irratti hojjetaa turanitti kan rukutaman yoo ta’u, iddoon kunis barattootaafi jiraattota naannichaan yeroo hundaa kan fayyadamuudha. Gochi kunis gochaa jeequmsaafi dhiibbaa gareen kun namoota Falastiin irratti raawwachaa jiran keessaa tokko dha.

title: Israel and Lebanon to meet in Rome in October, US State Department official says
english: Israel and Lebanon are scheduled to hold discussions in Rome this October regarding a security deal mediated by the United States. While previous talks in August did not result in an agreement, officials believe this framework is essential for maintaining peace and sovereignty. Representatives from both nations are also set to meet in Washington next week to continue these efforts.

title: Israeli forces detain foreign activist at Al-Mughayyir checkpoint
english: Israeli military personnel arrested a foreign activist and confiscated their vehicle at a security checkpoint near the village of Al-Mughayyir in the West Bank. The operation was part of intensified movement restrictions that have caused significant travel delays for local residents. Authorities have continued to maintain strict control over access points leading into the village.

Humnoonni Israa'el daandii gara gandattii geessu irratti to'annoo cimaa gochuu itti fufaniiru.

title: Houthi media reports Saudi strikes in northern Yemen
english: Houthi-affiliated media sources stated that Saudi Arabia conducted airstrikes and artillery attacks in Yemen's Saada province, a primary base for the Houthi movement. In response, Saudi Arabian authorities issued temporary emergency warnings regarding possible retaliatory attacks in areas near the Yemeni border. These alerts for the cities of Abha and Khamis Mushait were subsequently canceled shortly after being issued.

Akeekkachiisni magaalaalee Abhaa fi Khamis Mushait irratti kenname ture dafee kan kaafame ta’uun beekameera.

title: Russia struck train near Poland border shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials passed through
english: A Russian drone strike hit a train engine near the Ukrainian border with Poland shortly after it was used to transport former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and other international officials. Although the attack caused no injuries, Ukrainian officials believe the diplomatic train may have been the intended target. The incident has prompted renewed calls from leaders for increased air defense systems and stronger sanctions against Russia.

title: Turkish police detain dozens in raids on gay bars and homes of LGBTQ+ activists
english: Turkish authorities have detained 47 individuals during widespread raids across 12 provinces targeting LGBTQ+ activists and venues. The government claims these actions are part of a campaign to protect family values, while human rights groups argue the initiative is a form of state-sponsored discrimination. Officials have also sought to restrict online content and social media accounts linked to various LGBTQ+ organizations.

title: Ukrainian drone evades Russian helicopter fire to strike oil tanker
english: A Ukrainian drone successfully dodged gunfire from a Russian helicopter before hitting an oil tanker in the Black Sea. Ukraine released video evidence of the operation, which is part of its ongoing strategy to disrupt ships that facilitate Russian oil exports. This strike highlights the escalating efforts by Ukraine to target logistical assets supporting Russia's war economy.

title: Kosovo approves new government after months of political deadlock
english: Kosovo's parliament has finally formed a new government led by Prime Minister Albin Kurti, ending a three-month political stalemate. Despite this progress, the country remains unstable as it struggles to secure enough votes to elect a new president. If the parliament fails to reach an agreement soon, Kosovo may be forced to conduct its fourth snap election in just two years.

oromo: Paarlaamaan Koosovoo mootummaa haaraa Albiin Kuurtii durfamu erga mirkaneessee booda, rakkoo siyaasaa ji'oota sadiif turerraa boqonnaa argateera. Ta'us, biyyattiin pirezidaantii haaraa filachuuf sagalee gahaa argachuu waan dadhabdeef, tasgabbii dhabuun itti fufeera. title: F1 leader Antonelli wins Spanish Grand Prix as unlucky Norris misses out
english: Andrea Kimi Antonelli won the Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid after a strategic virtual safety car period allowed him to overtake Lando Norris. Although Norris dominated much of the race, a problematic pit stop following the safety car disadvantage cost him the victory. This win extends Antonelli’s lead in the Formula One championship to 81 points over his teammate George Russell.

title: Six killed, 130 missing after Indonesian passenger ship capsizes
english: A passenger ship recently capsized in the Java Sea off the coast of Indonesia, resulting in the confirmed deaths of six individuals. While 107 people were successfully rescued from the vessel, which was carrying a total of 243 passengers, at least 130 people remain missing. Rescue operations are currently being significantly hindered by dangerous weather conditions and high waves.

title: World leaders gather in New Delhi for final day of BRICS summit
english: Global leaders have convened in New Delhi for the concluding day of the BRICS summit. Despite internal disagreements regarding the ongoing conflicts in Ukraine and Iran, the member nations are focused on demonstrating unity. The group aims to bolster the influence of developing nations and advocate for a global political structure that moves away from a single-power dominance.
amharic: የዓለም መሪዎች በኒው ዴሊ በተካሄደው የብሪክስ (BRICS) ጉባኤ የመጨረሻ ቀን ተገናኝተዋል። ምንም እንኳን በዩክሬን እና በኢራን ግጭቶች ዙሪያ በአባል ሀገራት መካከል ልዩነቶች ቢኖሩም፣ ቡድኑ አንድነቱን ለማሳየት ጥረት እያደረገ ነው። ጉባኤው የዓለም አቀፍ ደቡብ ሀገራትን ተጽእኖ ለማሳደግ እና ብዙ ወገን ያለው የዓለም ስርአትን ለመፍጠር ያለመ ነው።

title: Iran war reshapes Brics ties but also exposes divisions
english: Leaders from the BRICS nations recently met in Delhi to discuss their collective role in the global order, highlighting India's diplomatic skill in bringing together countries with significant internal disagreements. While nations like Russia, China, and Iran view the group as a way to challenge Western influence, India is actively working to ensure the alliance remains neutral rather than anti-Western. Despite the desire for closer cooperation, deep-seated regional conflicts, such as the tensions surrounding the war in the Middle East, continue to expose major divisions among the members.

title: Six dead, 130 missing after Indonesian ferry capsizes in Java Sea
english: An Indonesian passenger ferry sank in the Java Sea after encountering severe weather while traveling to Banjarmasin. At least six people have died, and emergency teams are currently searching for 130 passengers who remain missing. Over 280 personnel, including navy and rescue agency staff, are involved in the ongoing effort to locate survivors.

title: How Israel’s destruction of south Lebanon is making displacement permanent
english: The intense military conflict between Israel and Hezbollah has caused widespread devastation in southern Lebanon, leaving hundreds of thousands of people displaced. Although the number of refugees has decreased from its peak, humanitarian experts warn that the situation remains fragile because destroyed infrastructure and persistent security threats prevent many from returning home. This ongoing crisis is creating a long-term displacement problem as the destruction of livelihoods and housing continues to hinder a return to normalcy.
